headline: 3P Land Holdings reports September quarter financial results
summary: 3P Land Holdings Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the exchange. These filings provide routine updates on the company's financial performance for the quarter. Retail investors holding the stock can review the official filing for specific revenue and profit figures. The disclosure enables market participants to assess the company's ongoing operational standing.
why_it_matters: Quarterly financial numbers determine the company's recent operational performance.

headline: 3P Land Holdings shares postal ballot proceedings
hook: Routine corporate filing from 3P Land Holdings
summary: 3P Land Holdings Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the proceedings of its recent postal ballot. Shareholders participated in voting on resolutions presented by the company management. The outcome of the ballot dictates procedural corporate governance actions. Retail investors in micro-cap real estate stocks see standard regulatory compliance updates.
why_it_matters: Standard procedural filing with no immediate financial impact

headline: 3P Land Holdings completes share dematerialisation for Q2 FY2026
summary: 3P Land Holdings has confirmed the successful dematerialisation of its shares for the second quarter of the 2026 fiscal year. The process adheres to all regulatory requirements set by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). This administrative update ensures the company remains in compliance with mandatory electronic holding standards. Retail investors holding physical shares should ensure their records are updated to reflect this status.
why_it_matters: Ensures continued regulatory compliance for existing shareholders.
